28cb6417-a29f-4e3b-8c73-ec0cec06e0df.name: Act of Treason
rules: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn.

5c254101-7474-4023-a582-d31cc63172de.name: Radiation
rules: At the beginning of each player's precombat main phase, if that player has one or more rad counters, mill that many cards. For each nonland card milled this way, you lose 1 life and remove one rad counter.
